comments.note: Added inline comment to Constructor_RegistersSixDestinations test listing the 6 expected destination IDs in order: 'movies, library-folders, refresh, filters, settings, bookmarks'. This resolves the brittleness concern raised in the Developer's own debt comment (the magic number 6 is now self-documenting). No behavioral change.

NavigateToMovieEditorAsync shared helper is a clean, well-structured refactor. Both OnEditMovieRequested and OnBookmarkNavigateToMovieRequested delegate to the same helper, eliminating duplicate movie-lookup-then-push logic. Error handling and null-guard coverage is thorough.

Dispose() implementation is comprehensive — all five subscription/unsubscription pairs are present and null-guarded: NavigationChanged, ActiveDestinationChanged, StateChanged, EditMovieRequested, and the new NavigateToMovieRequested. No memory-leak risk.

BookmarksBrowserViewModel is AddSingleton (preserves pagination/filter state across nav switches); BookmarksBrowserView and BookmarksPanelView are AddTransient (ViewLocator creates fresh instances per presentation). This matches the established pattern for other stateful singletons (SettingsViewModel, ObfuscationSettingsViewModel).
